Translates PDF text on-device into another language using ML Kit. OCR text recognition must be run first. Language models (~15–30 MB each) are downloaded automatically on first use and stay on-device.
On-device translation of PDF text into 10 languages (EN, DE, ES, FR, PT, RU, AR, HI, ZH, JA) via ML Kit. Language models are downloaded on first use; no text leaves the device.

The optional Translate PDF feature uses ML Kit Translate to translate OCR-extracted text on-device into one of 10 supported languages. Language models (~15–30 MB each) are downloaded automatically on first use via Google Play Services and remain on the device. No document text is transmitted to any server.
